card.name: Small words before warning-sign terms
card.fires_on: Short linking words or word endings right before a named problem in warnings. Mostly 'for' after monitor/observe/follow patients closely, also 'of' in 'Lack of' and 'ed' in 'Delayed'.

modes.label: Monitor for
modes.description: The word 'for' after a monitoring verb, leading into signs or symptoms to watch.
modes.example: Monitor closely<< for>> signs of respiratory depression and sedation [

modes.label: Warning headings
modes.description: A word or ending inside a warning heading, just before the problem is named.

modes.label: Show no evidence
modes.description: The word 'no' after 'show' in a stop-treatment instruction.
modes.example: Discontinue therapy in patients who show<< no>> evidence of therapeutic benefit by Week 1
